module text.initials
  purpose: Derive the initials of a person's full name.

public function initials(name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a full name, joined with nothing between them. Blank or extra spaces are ignored.
  tags: text, names
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  ada   lovelace ") is "AL"
  example: initials("grace") is "G"
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let parts be name.split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each part in parts
    where not part.is_empty()
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end

module text.initials
  purpose: Derive short initials from full names.

public function initials(name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a name, joined with nothing between them, ignoring blank or extra spaces.
  tags: text, names
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  grace    hopper ") is "GH"
  example: initials("plato") is "P"
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let parts be name.split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each part in parts
    where not part.is_empty()
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end

test "initials of a three word name"
  check initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
end

test "extra spaces are ignored"
  check initials("  grace    hopper ") is "GH"
end

test "a blank name has no initials"
  check initials("   ") is ""
end
